battlecards.why_selected: Maintained preferred brand equity while meeting target cost reductions; offered largest front-end price drop plus new marketing fund.
battlecards.contract_terms: Enterprise pricing agreement; new prices effective 10-Feb-2025 with quarterly true-ups and 3-year commercial commitment.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of shifting bulk volume to Chevron/Exxon, consolidated enterprise volume previously unknown to Shell, documented YOY volume decline used to justify margin reduction.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Strong brand recognition with fleet customers, broad SKU coverage, national distribution network, co-op marketing funds.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Historic pricing creep, limited price transparency on packaged goods.
battlecards.switching_costs: Changing customer-facing brand signage, technician retraining, purge/flush of bulk tanks.
battlecards.key_contacts: Carmela Cochrane – Key Account Manager; John Walters – On-Hwy Team Lead
battlecards.notes: Marketing fund improved by $27K annually and Lucas grease pricing reduced an additional $33K.

battlecards.why_selected: Competitive net pricing on synthetic SKUs and willingness to retro-bill price errors back to 1-Mar-2025.
battlecards.contract_terms: Lubricants Supply Agreement extended to 29-Feb-2028 (Amendment No. 6); price list locked for 12 months with ≤3% annual cap thereafter.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Documented billing errors, ability to allocate incremental share to Shell, multi-site consolidated demand.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Premium Delo brand, technical support team, bulk and packaged options.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Slower price file updates created invoice errors; smaller marketing fund than Shell.
battlecards.switching_costs: Tank cleaning, filter changeovers, customer perception of changing brands.
battlecards.notes: Chevron agreed to credit invoices and issue corrected retro-billing for all shipments since 1-Mar-2025.

battlecards.why_selected: Agreed to match Shell bulk pricing on top SKUs and introduced anniversary promotion valued at $150K.
battlecards.contract_terms: New enterprise price file effective 1-Mar-2025; rebates tiered by total Mobil gallons with annual true-up.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Potential loss of share to Shell, consolidated volume visibility, timing before Mobil Delvac 100th anniversary promo.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Strong OEM approvals, marketing promotions, reliable distributor network.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher packaged pricing than peers, rebate complexity.
battlecards.switching_costs: Same as other oil majors—bulk tank purge and customer brand impact.

battlecards.why_selected: Matched Baldwin pricing on high-run SKUs while maintaining OEM spec quality; agreed to single national price list.
battlecards.contract_terms: Enterprise pricing agreement effective Jan-2025; quarterly rebate payable based on consolidated volumes.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat to divert volume to Baldwin, ability to showcase cross-reference savings analysis.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: OEM-grade filtration, broad SKU match, strong technical data.
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal—filters interchangeable; primary cost is system price file update.
battlecards.notes: Invoices collected (FGUSA- series) confirm new pricing live 19-Feb-2025.

battlecards.why_selected: Provided tiered volume rebate up to 5% and agreed to national shipment support.
battlecards.contract_terms: MOU effective 1-Feb-2025 through 31-Dec-2025 with annual rebate true-up; option to extend.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Epika growth story and risk of SKU rationalization toward Fleetguard only.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Largest HD filter catalog, fast lead times, rebate flexibility.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Lower OEM brand equity vs Fleetguard, some SKUs priced above market.
battlecards.switching_costs: Low—filters interchangeable; admin to change SKUs in POS.

battlecards.why_selected: Highest guaranteed effective rebate (1.8%) and Mastercard acceptance network; scalable implementation plan.
battlecards.contract_terms: Comdata Mastercard Corporate Card Agreement #00818987; 3-year initial term starting 28-Feb-2025 with auto-renewal.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Single enterprise award of >$4.5M fuel spend, competitive bids from 3 other issuers.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Universal acceptance, advanced fraud controls, implementation team assigned.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Requires switch to new card platform and driver training.
battlecards.switching_costs: Card re-issuance, system integration with expense tools, driver onboarding.
battlecards.notes: Implementation kickoff held 29-Jan-2025; template with all Epika operating companies submitted.

battlecards.supplier_name: Office Depot / ODP Business Solutions (via OMNIA)
battlecards.why_selected: Immediate access to OMNIA Tier-1 discount structure without RFP; one vendor able to service all locations.
battlecards.contract_terms: Participating addendum executed Q1-2025; pricing tied to OMNIA Contract #R191902 through 4-30-2026 with two 12-month renewals.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Leverage of OMNIA national volume and credible threat to leave Amazon/Staples.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Wide SKU breadth, next-day delivery, aggressive GPO pricing.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Requires internal adoption of punch-out catalog; back-order risk in remote branches.
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal—new vendor account setup and user training.

battlecards.why_selected: OMNIA savings assessment showed 17% price drop on high-usage list and ability to cover 100% of requirements.
battlecards.contract_terms: OMNIA Contract #R192006 participation; pricing fixed for 12 months with quarterly price audit rights.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Demonstrated SKU-level savings analysis; willingness to consolidate Airgas MRO items.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Extensive catalog, integrated e-procurement, national logistics.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Potential freight charges on low-value orders.
battlecards.switching_costs: User training on new punch-out; phasing out local Imperial representatives.

battlecards.why_selected: Offered 15% price reduction on market basket plus tiered rebate up to 5% over $2 M spend.
battlecards.contract_terms: Proposed agreement: 1-year base term with automatic 1-year renewals; rebate: 1% <$1M, 2% <$2M, 5% >$2M (paid annually).
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of retaining incumbents, consolidated $2.3M spend visibility, ability to shift volume quickly.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Competitive pricing, willingness to commit to rebate, broad heavy-duty inventory.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: New relationship—limited performance history with Epika, potential onboarding hiccups.
battlecards.switching_costs: System SKU mapping, credit setup, possible freight variance.
battlecards.notes: Award is contingent on CST&T leadership final approval expected 30-Apr-2025.

summary.skipped_reason: Suppliers in simple renewals or with only basic spend data (e.g., Telematics-Samsara, Uniforms, Telecom) were skipped due to limited strategic content.
